$comment: EMPTY ON PURPOSE — and that is a fact about WHERE SALES IS, not an oversight.
Sales' only current dependency that ships code is bizapps-common, and common IS published to
npm (@mj-biz-apps/common-* at 5.32.0). So the registry resolves everything the S0/S1 scaffold
needs and there is nothing to symlink. link-local-apps.mjs exits 0 on an empty `links` map, so
postinstall stays a no-op rather than a warning.
WHEN THIS FILE STARTS EARNING ITS KEEP: at S2, the pricing bridge. `Orders.PreviewOrder` is the
only thing allowed to produce a number in this app (master plan §6), and bizapps-orders is NOT
published — neither is bizapps-accounting, which orders itself hard-requires. At that point sales
is three symlink-hops deep (sales -> orders -> accounting -> common) and every caveat in the
sibling copy of this file applies with more force, not less: type-graphql / graphql /
reflect-metadata must collapse to ONE copy or buildSchema dies on a decorator that is perfectly
correct. See bizapps-orders/.mj-links.json SHARED_IDENTITY for the full account.
The entries that will go here, in dependency order, once those repos are built locally:
Do NOT add them speculatively. An entry whose target is not BUILT produces a 'not built (missing
dist/index.js)' warning on every install and a resolution failure at boot, which is worse than
the honest 404 you get from not declaring it at all.
